## RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: caution  
Risk: medium  
Confidence: 0.60  
Rationale: FY2025 XBRL OCF $5.45bn and FCF $4.20bn (≈4.3× dividends) align with the screen’s annual cash metrics, but Yahoo TTM FCF ~$346m and 9M26 filing OCF $1.79bn vs $5.77bn y/y weaken near-term buy support.  
RiskTags: regulatory, cyclical, litigation

## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/adb01c0e0ac93bc6.txt] "Cash flows provided by operating activities of $5.5 billion, with cash flows from operations before working capital 1,3 of $2.7 billion" — FY2025 operating cash generation supporting annual screen inputs  
- [filings/bodies/adb01c0e0ac93bc6.txt] "Net cash provided by operating activities (1) 5,452 2,790" — Statutory OCF rebound vs FY2024 in the FY2025 results exhibit  
- [filings/bodies/adb01c0e0ac93bc6.txt] "Announces increase in quarterly dividend, marking 53 consecutive years of dividend growth" — Dividend policy continuity (no interim cut in sources)  
- [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt] "Net cash provided by operating activities 1,788 5,765" — Nine months ended Sep-2026 OCF well below prior-year period (TTM/screen tension)  
- [filings/bodies/bd132b50323c9cfb.txt] "investigation by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and the Department of Justice (“DOJ”) relating to, among other things, intersegment sales" — Regulatory enforcement backdrop  
- [filings/bodies/bd132b50323c9cfb.txt] "has agreed to pay a civil penalty of $40 million and to cease and desist" — Resolved SEC matter with penalty (governance/regulatory)  
- [filings/bodies/19af0fa0680ee358.txt] "commodity prices, interest rates, and foreign exchange rates, which can negatively affect margins, inventory values, and hedging positions" — Cyclical/market-risk framing in FY2025 10-K  
- [filings/bodies/8945993cd70e77f4.txt] "External factors across the macroeconomic, geopolitical, policy, and trade environments continue to be monitored" — Ongoing macro/policy uncertainty in 3Q26 outlook  

### NUMBERS

- Operating cash flow | 5452000000.0 USD | FY ended 2025-12-31 (form 10-K, filed 2026-02-17) | [sec_companyfacts.json]  
- Capital expenditure (PP&E) | 1248000000.0 USD | FY ended 2025-12-31 (form 10-K, filed 2026-02-17) | [sec_companyfacts.json]  
- Free cash flow (OCF − PP&E capex) | 4204000000.0 USD | FY ended 2025-12-31 | [sec_companyfacts.json]  
- Dividends paid | 987000000.0 USD | FY ended 2025-12-31 (form 10-K, filed 2026-02-17) | [sec_companyfacts.json]  
- Net cash provided by operating activities | 1,788 (millions) | Nine months ended 2026-09-30 | [filings/bodies/e7d8dfc9423bb122.txt]  
- Free cash flow TTM | 346000000.0 | Yahoo-derived TTM in snapshot (not FY filing basis) | [screening_snapshot.json]  

### THESIS BREAKS

- Two consecutive fiscal years with filing-derived FCF (OCF minus PP&E capex) below cash dividends paid on the same statutory basis.  
- New SEC/DOJ enforcement or material restatement tied to intersegment or segment reporting beyond the January 2026 settlement disclosed in sources.  
- Nine-month or full-year operating cash flow trending toward levels that no longer cover dividends and maintenance capex without rising net debt (not observed in FY2025 10-K).  
- Sustained GAAP EPS and operating profit decline alongside negative working-capital-driven OCF without disclosed one-off reversals in SEC interim filings.
